_doc: QUEUE 0a per-row predicates. Every Gap Register row graded C3 or C4 names the machine check that holds it there. kind 'test': repo paths that tools/ci_pytest.py collects, so the required pytest job IS the predicate (a red test is a red build). kind 'measured' / 'sibling': the evidence lives on the tower or in a sibling repo, so this repo's CI can only read it as UNKNOWN -- and UNKNOWN carries an age budget (GC-1): measured_on + budget_days. Past budget the row is STALE: the nightly escalates, and no PR may raise a row to C3+ on stale evidence. Re-measure, then bump measured_on with the citation. Checked by tools/row_predicates.py.
